description: This file defines a class `_ENTERPRISE_OpenAI_Moderation` that integrates OpenAI moderation features into a proxy system for a large language model application. It includes a method for handling moderation hooks that process message data, invoke moderation checks via a router, and enforce safety policies by raising HTTP exceptions.
